'''Brittany Lauda''' is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Lauda was born on February 18, 1993, and graduated from high school in 2011. As an adult, she became a voice actress and worked on English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series, as well as some video games and {{wp|My Little Pony}} official apps. Lauda joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} in the middle of {{aniseries|XY}}.
